summary.text: Ross Metler is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 23, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Alexis Hoffkling (D).
A software developer and data analyst from Wheat Ridge, he is legislative director for the Libertarian Party of Colorado, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Metler said he is a software developer and data analyst who builds civic data tools and has spent years reading Colorado legislation line by line.
He said he lives in Wheat Ridge and serves as legislative director for the Libertarian Party of Colorado, following bills at the Capitol from introduction to signature.
